title: Questions 149-150 refer to the following announcement.
passage_1:
New Online Tool: Gear Value Calculator

Lumen Camera Exchange is glad to present the Instant Gear Calculator on our Web site. This service was built to help photographers who are planning to purchase a new camera estimate their overall spending.

You can now clarify what your existing equipment is worth without leaving your home. Just select the “Trade-in” tab, and type in your camera’s release year, model name, and shutter count. You will also need to choose the item’s physical grade from a drop-down list.

The calculator will then give you an estimate of the store credit you may apply to anything in our showroom. Go to www.lumenexchange.com today!
